game_concept: A arcade set in The Kingdom – Royal Granary, the king's grain stores: the squire must handle siege rats while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Variable Crates: Drag collected apples into labelled variable crates, then read each crate's value to feed the castle gate.
theme: The Kingdom – Royal Granary: the king's grain stores
core_gameplay_loop: In Royal Granary, repeat each round: Drag collected apples into labelled variable crates, then read each crate's value to feed the castle gate. Each round, a new apples challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the crate_b value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 100 points of apples by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 100, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 1 (intro tier): Variable Crates
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Variable Crates' (Week 1 slot 1), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Royal Granary'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how crate_b changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against siege rats in Royal Granary.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 100 within 30 seconds.
